name: Japan Post Insurance
summary: Japan Post Insurance Co., Ltd. primarily operates as a life insurance provider within Japan. Beyond its core offerings, the company also furnishes administrative and agency support for other insurance firms, including international ones, as well as for various financial services companies. Additionally, it provides loan guarantees. The company actively participates in financial markets, engaging in the trading of government and government-guaranteed bonds, handling subscriptions for corporate, government, and other bonds, and conducting commissioned management activities. A significant aspect of its business includes the management of postal life insurance policies. Japan Post Insurance distributes its products and services to both individual and corporate clients through a network of agencies and directly managed sales offices. Established in 2006, the company is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
